main_scope: One additional independent seed per fixed model and condition; combine with original exploratory trajectory only for two-run descriptive comparison.
initialization: Resume complete baseline memory, posts, comments, read IDs, statistics, exposures and events. Change only target_cycles100to200 and completedTrue toFalse in a copied checkpoint.
source_memory: The source retains its private glossary as an explicit persistent source, outside the mutable memory cap. Source agent excluded from reach outcomes.
schedule: Sequential cycles; agents0–9 each take one turn. Model selects read/write; reading selects one unread other-authored post with a fixed seeded random stream and optionally comments. Up to3latest comments are visible with that post. Earlier same-cycle outputs may be read by later agents.
memory: Summarize before a turn if mutable memory exceeds1000characters; generated summary is truncated to500characters. Empty outputs/errors stop execution, never become memory-as-message fallbacks.

generation.action_decoder: Sample constrained0/1; read/write and read/comment label orders deterministically counterbalanced by task across all models.

metrics.primary: All60 literal generated occurrences, repeats included, per100messages and1000characters in each20-cycle bin and in1-100 vs101-200; source and non-source separate.
metrics.secondary: Target-bearing message proportion, distinct used terms, concentration, realized exposure/read behavior, new first-use events after100 and cumulative first-use reach.
metrics.limit: A greater cumulative count at200 is not by itself evidence of sustained or accelerating circulation; no population-model inference or semantic understanding claim.

differences_from_recovered_historical_co: One incoming post per read turn, rather than all unread posts
Latest three comments can enter another agent input
Length ceilings enforced and raw output retained
Constrained numeric action interface; identical meaning across templates
Missing source example omitted rather than inserting nan
All requests/exposures and states logged; no empty-output memory fallback
technical_gate: Byte-identical baseline inference runner, source/input hash checks, exact checkpoint continuation tests and preservation of original100-cycle state/log prefixes. No separateLLM pilot that changes state.
artifacts: Raw data, audit and two-run statistical description only. No automatic manuscript edits or publication.
run_mode: Continue each completed freshStudy1 checkpoint from next_cycle101 through200; never restart or replay inference for1-100.
question: Does use persist, increase or decay in cycles101-200 of the same baseline trajectories?
stopping: Fixed endpoint200, regardless of favorable/unfavorable trends. No automatic300/500 extension or repeats.
